name: anim_jyu_slam_sway4
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches and a big round belly
desc: Loop: facing straight toward the viewer with both hands on his hips, he lewdly and teasingly rolls his hips in a slow, heavy, sticky grind: first he pushes his hips far out to his left and lingers there, then rolls them slowly through the center and far out to his right and lingers again, then back to the center. His whole body follows the grind: the upper body turns toward each side so one shoulder comes forward, the knees bend and the body sinks low at each side and rises in the middle, and the head tilts with the body while he keeps looking down at the viewer with a heavy, smug, leering gaze. The big belly and chest wobble and sway heavily a moment after the hips, like thick liquid. Every motion is very slow, smooth and gooey, easing in and out. The face keeps exactly the same eyebrows, nose, closed mouth and half-lidded eyes. Thick, sticky, viscous paint.
